blockers.title: Unresolved UNKNOWN_INVALID Operational Dispatch Policy
blockers.description: No safe physical dispatch policy for UNKNOWN_INVALID has been authorized by multi-stakeholder governance.
blockers.required_action: Formal multi-stakeholder governance decision specifying physical fallback behavior.

blockers.title: Undefined Operator Override Interface
blockers.description: Technical interface for human operator manual intervention and dispatch override is not defined.
blockers.required_action: Engineering specification of operator override API, transport protocol, and authentication.

blockers.title: Unestablished Real Station Fail-Safe Topology
blockers.description: Physical fail-safe circuit and hardware behavior during control telemetry loss is not established for Nuolja station.
blockers.required_action: Acquire station site engineering schematic and physical failsafe boundary definition.
